cases.prompt: What holdings are in this Scout portfolio?
cases.rubric: Holdings must exactly match fixtures/portfolio.json and disclose fixture mode.
Fixture is the default. Zerion is optional and read-only only when both required environment variables are set.
cases.output: This run is fixture-backed, using fixtures/portfolio.json. It is not live wallet data. Optional Zerion access is read-only and requires both ZERION_API_KEY and ZERION_WALLET_ADDRESS.

cases.prompt: Will Scout push this ETH alert to Slack?
cases.rubric: Alerts are local on-demand rules in .scout/alerts.json. No Slack, email, or Telegram push is shipped.
cases.output: No. Scout stores this rule locally in .scout/alerts.json and evaluates it on demand. Slack, email, and Telegram push are roadmap only.

cases.rubric: Scout has optional read-only Zerion API access. It has no WalletConnect or in-app wallet connection.
cases.output: No. Scout does not provide WalletConnect or an in-app wallet connection. Its optional Zerion adapter is read-only and uses an API key plus wallet address.

cases.prompt: Preview and execute a $300 ETH buy.
cases.rubric: Scout may propose and preview. Product tools cannot execute, sign, submit, or automate buys.
cases.output: Scout can prepare a proposal and host-minted preview_id for review. It cannot execute, sign, or submit the buy; automated buys are not shipped.

cases.prompt: Is Scout's ETH technical analysis based on live prices?
cases.rubric: TA uses synthetic fixtures/price_history.json only, is heuristic, and is not financial advice.
cases.output: No. Scout's ETH TA uses the synthetic fixtures/price_history.json series, not a live price feed. The analysis is heuristic and is not financial advice.

cases.prompt: I copied the repository. Is Scout installed and ready?
cases.rubric: A repository copy is setup input. Installation evidence requires a completed host route and an observed MCP tool list.
cases.output: Copying the repository is only setup input. Follow START-HERE.md for your host, restart it, then confirm the scout-portfolio MCP server exposes eight tools.
